title: US allows Nvidia H200 exports to China
body: On December 8, 2025, President Trump announced the US would allow Nvidia to ship H200 chips to China in exchange for a 25% fee on such sales.

context.text: Silicon Thaw: Alibaba Shares Surge as U.S. Eases Path for Nvidia’s H200 Chips into China
why: The US reversal of export controls let Nvidia ship H200 GPUs to China under a revenue fee, reopening a major blocked market.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA announces Vera Rubin platform at GTC
body: NVIDIA announced the Vera Rubin platform with Rubin GPU and Vera CPU at GTC on March 16, 2026, with seven new chips in full production.

context.text: Nvidia GTC 2026 Kicks Off in San Jose, Igniting a Tech-Wide Rally as 'Rubin' Architecture and Physical AI Take Center Stage
why: Vera Rubin is NVIDIA's next major AI compute platform, resetting its multi-year product roadmap and data center outlook.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA Q1 FY2027 results and $80B buyback
body: NVIDIA reported Q1 FY2027 revenue of $81.6 billion and announced an $80 billion share repurchase authorization with a dividend increase to $0.25 per share.

context.text: Nvidia earnings live updates: The key numbers to watch for in the report
why: NVIDIA's Q1 FY2027 revenue of $81.6B and $80B buyback signaled massive cash generation and capital return to investors.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA joins KKR Helix launch
body: NVIDIA partnered with KKR, the Kuwait Investment Authority and Vistra to launch Helix Digital Infrastructure with over $10 billion of committed capital to support AI data center, power and connectivity build-out.

context.text: KKR Launches $10 Billion AI Infrastructure Company With Nvidia, Vistra
why: NVIDIA partnered with KKR and Vistra to launch a $10B AI infrastructure company, materially expanding its hyperscaler reach.
date evidence (day)

title: Nvidia raises $25B in oversubscribed bond sale
body: Nvidia announced on June 15, 2026 it would raise $25 billion through a bond issuance that attracted about $85 billion in investor demand, its first corporate bond sale since 2021.

context.text: The AI Trade Is Moving From Nvidia To The Bond Market - NVIDIA  ( NASDAQ:NVDA )
why: NVIDIA raised $25B in bonds with huge demand, marking a major shift to debt markets to fund AI expansion.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA and Firmus sign 170,000 GPU AI deal
body: NVIDIA partnered with Australia's Firmus Technologies on a strategic compute partnership with up to 170,000 GPUs and US$25–30 billion in expected offtake over six years, announced June 29, 2026.

context.text: Australia's Firmus Technologies strikes AI access deal with Nvidia
why: NVIDIA signed a $30B six-year cloud services deal with Firmus, a large distribution agreement changing its cloud revenue outlook.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA launches Japan national AI infrastructure
body: NVIDIA announced a partnership with Noetra Corp. and METI to build the world's first national AI infrastructure for physical AI using 13,750 Vera CPUs and 27,500 Rubin GPUs, while Japan's AI robotics strategy targets a $133B market by 2040.

context.text: Jensen Huang Turns to Japan’s Robots for Nvidia’s Next Growth Engine
why: A $133B Japan physical AI deal with Noetra reshapes NVIDIA's sovereign AI and robotics revenue outlook.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA and SK Group announce $500B-plus AI partnership
body: NVIDIA and SK Group announced a $500-billion-plus partnership to build AI factories including a 2-gigawatt SK Telecom AI factory and co-develop next-generation AI memory with SK hynix.

context.text: Nvidia chief says will announce $500 bil. partnership with SK Group in meeting with Lee
why: A $500B partnership with SK Group materially expands NVIDIA's AI factory and memory roadmap in South Korea.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA signs $500B AI financing MOUs
body: NVIDIA signed MOUs with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital for AI infrastructure financing.

context.text: Six Firms Sign MOUs With NVIDIA to Fund AI Infrastructure
why: NVIDIA signed MOUs with six major asset managers to mobilize over $500B in third-party AI infrastructure capital, reshaping its financing scale.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 revenue $96.2B
body: NVIDIA reported fiscal Q2 revenue of $96.22 billion, beating estimates and guiding approximately 70% fiscal 2028 growth.

context.text: Nvidia earnings live updates: Q2 results, memory prices and AI outlook
why: NVIDIA reported record Q2 FY2027 revenue of $96.2B, confirming accelerating AI demand and materially beating estimates.
date evidence (day)

title: AWS and NVIDIA announce 2M additional GPUs
body: AWS and NVIDIA announced on August 26, 2026 that AWS plans to deploy 2 million additional NVIDIA GPUs across its global infrastructure in 2027-2028, building on a prior commitment of over 1 million GPUs.

context.text: Amazon Just Committed to 2 Million More Nvidia GPUs, and the Stock Traded Lower
why: AWS committed to 2 million additional NVIDIA GPUs by 2028, tripling total committed volume and securing a massive multi-year demand outlook.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA invests $3.5B in MediaTek, adopts NVLink Fusion
body: NVIDIA invested $3.5 billion in MediaTek convertible bonds and MediaTek adopted the NVLink Fusion platform for custom XPUs across edge-to-cloud AI platforms.

context.text: NVIDIA and MediaTek Deepen Long-Standing Partnership to Build AI Edge to Cloud Computing Platforms
why: A $3.5B investment in MediaTek with NVLink Fusion expansion extends NVIDIA's interconnect standard into custom XPUs and edge-to-cloud platforms.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA to Acquire Hugging Face for $12.93B
body: NVIDIA announced a definitive agreement to acquire Hugging Face for $12.93 billion, marking its second-biggest acquisition on record after the $20 billion Groq assets purchase.

context.text: NVIDIA to Acquire Hugging Face
why: Acquiring Hugging Face for ~$13B expands NVIDIA's AI software ecosystem and is its second-largest acquisition ever.
date evidence (day)

title: NVIDIA authorizes $150B buyback increase to $235B
body: NVIDIA's Board of Directors authorized an additional $150 billion under its share repurchase program on September 28, 2026, raising the total remaining authorization to $235 billion to be executed through fiscal year 2028.

context.text: Nvidia Adds $150 Billion to Massive Stock Buyback, the Largest Ever
why: A $150B buyback increase to $235B total is the largest capital return authorization in history and materially changes shareholder returns.
date evidence (day)
